name: Linus Torvalds
content: A strong software developer combines technical depth with practical problem-solving. Building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and useful is what makes engineering work truly valuable.

name: Guido van Rossum
content: Clear thinking and simplicity are powerful qualities in software development. Good engineering should make complex problems easier to understand, build, and maintain.

name: Brendan Eich
content: Innovation comes from turning ideas into working technology. Developers who experiment, learn continuously, and build useful solutions can have a meaningful impact on the digital world.

name: Bjarne Stroustrup
content: Professional software development requires both strong technical foundations and an understanding of the problems technology is meant to solve. Well-designed software should remain useful beyond its initial implementation.
